# Empty Leg List

> A listing of empty leg private jet flights published by charter operators, collected in one place and shown live at https://emptylegslist.com. Empty Leg List is a listing service operated by Publishing Office SRL. It is not a broker and not an operator; enquiries go to the operator that published the flight.

An empty leg is a one-way repositioning flight that a charter operator has to fly anyway and offers at a reduced price. The board shows each flight as the operator listed it: route, date, aircraft type, seats where given, and the operator's published price or "price on enquiry".

## Live board

- [All empty legs](https://emptylegslist.com/): the live list, filterable by departure, arrival, date, aircraft and region
- [Last minute empty legs](https://emptylegslist.com/last-minute-empty-leg-flights): flights departing in the next seven days
- [Live map](https://emptylegslist.com/map): the same flights on a map

## Browse by place and aircraft

- [Empty legs by city](https://emptylegslist.com/empty-legs/): one page per departure city, for example https://emptylegslist.com/empty-legs/london
- [Empty legs by route](https://emptylegslist.com/empty-legs/): one page per city pair, for example https://emptylegslist.com/empty-legs/london-to-nice
- [Empty legs by aircraft](https://emptylegslist.com/aircraft/): one page per aircraft type with specifications and a monthly record, for example https://emptylegslist.com/aircraft/challenger-350

## Data

- [Open data feed](https://emptylegslist.com/open-data): the flights on the board as free JSON (https://emptylegslist.com/feed/empty-legs.json) or CSV (https://emptylegslist.com/feed/empty-legs.csv), with documented fields and attribution terms
- [Empty legs API](https://emptylegslist.com/empty-legs-api): read-only REST access to the live board and the historical record, paid
